description: Ruby project tools (Bundler, RSpec, RuboCop, Standard, Brakeman): new gems, and install, test, and lint commands. `bundle exec` is a wrapper: the analysis checks the program after it.

rules.note: `bundle add` adds a gem to the Gemfile.
A mirror or a source in the Bundler settings changes where gems come from.

safe.note: `bundle install` installs the gems of Gemfile.lock. The other commands only check or list.
Tests, style checks, and security scans of the project.
